classicGeometryCheck.finding: The exact bundled Lemmini exit is 13 pixels below the Classic playable-height limit. This is an exact-target geometry mismatch to investigate separately from solver coverage; it is not an impossibility proof or source-physics parity result.

leads.reportedRoute: The author says the route solves the original 50-builder, 10-digger, 10-minute level. It does not work in NeoLemmix because it needs another Digger at the second-to-last obstacle; the author identifies different Digger and Builder behaviour.
leads.targetMatch: Reported original skillset and timer match the bundled text level; strict byte and level-revision correspondence remains unverified.

leads.reportedRoute: In an April 2026 reply, Kaywhyn says the original 50-builder, 10-digger solution works on the DOS version and SuperLemmini, but fails on NeoLemmix. The same post explains that the later NeoLemmix version changed the skillset and level geometry.
leads.targetMatch: Strengthens the source-route match for the bundled 50-builder, 10-digger original; it still does not prove strict playback on this exact bundled member.

leads.reportedRoute: Kaywhyn reports a winning route for the later 51-builder, 11-digger version. The post says the ordinary build-over route misses the 10-minute time limit.

The posts describe a save-all route that uses four required Diggers, then seven remaining Diggers to make a 28-pixel horizontal cut through a narrow, high pillar. Digging while facing away from the wall avoids a turn and saves time.
leads.targetMatch: These are NeoLemmix routes for the later pack revision, not the bundled SuperLemmini text level. Do not treat them as exact-target replays.

assessment: The 2024 public SuperLemmini replay was recovered. It reports the original 50-builder, 10-digger stock, and a 2026 forum post separately confirms the route on DOS and SuperLemmini. Its exact level revision is not embedded, and a heuristic transfer to the exact bundled member did not win. The retrieved later NeoLemmix replay targets a changed 51-builder, 11-digger revision. No strict native win, source-physics parity result, or difficulty score has been produced.
